DEWALT DPG82 Concealer Anti-Fog Safety Goggles Review

Wrap-around eye protection for hammering and chiseling

★★★★½4.6 / 5·~$13

Quick Verdict

The cheapest insurance on any rockhounding trip. Rhyolite and quartz send sharp chips when you hammer — these beat sunglasses every time.

Best for: Any trip where you're cracking rock

Pros & Cons

✓ What we like

  • •Anti-fog dual mold lens for hot desert days
  • •Wrap-around seal keeps rock chips out
  • •Fits over most prescription glasses
  • •Elastic strap — stays put when you're bent over a vug

✕ Watch out for

  • •Goggle style runs warmer than open safety glasses in mid-summer
